verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented public REST or GraphQL API: every OpenAPI/Swagger candidate path returned 404. Graphite can still be driven programmatically through its documented gt CLI and its official GT MCP server, which lets AI agents create stacked PRs. Those surfaces give agents only partial, indirect control rather than a general public API. Missing for 10: a documented public HTTP API covering reviews, merge queue, insights and agents; an OpenAPI spec; API auth/token docs; independent corroboration of API use.
